History


Early years and Popularity (2002–2006)
Jonezetta formed when its four members were still in high school.

However, at a gig in Monroe, LA, with the Christian Post-hardcore rock act As Cities Burn, Jonezetta met that band's manager, Ryan Rado; he encouraged the band to devote themselves more fully to their music.
